title: ID0428893-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / R3 170001595] Broken cable
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: we would like to report broken cable management system on
charger MP / R3 170001595.
Tape used under the clamp started slipping apart therefore cable is
not firmly attach to the clamp anymore and cable is touching the
ground.
Note that during installation we take care how many turns to do
with that tape.
Since this is happening on multiple sites of ours we conclude this is
the design flaw.
Thank you for creating the ticket.
Once it is open I will report how we solved it and claim the costs of
the repair and travel.
Solution: N/A
yyyy-mm-dd: 2025-05-21

additional_info.subject: Resolved by inhouse 3D printed solution
additional_info.body:
Dear support,
We solved the issue by placing 3D printed inserts between the cable and the clamp to secure better adherence to the cable surface. We installed our solution on May 21st 2025.
Best,
Milan
